rule: A flare counts as "followed by space rays" when a real-instrument (not model) NASA DONKI radiation-storm record from a GOES >10 MeV detector starts within 72 hours after the flare's peak. Only flares of class M5 or bigger are counted.
source: NASA DONKI FLR and SEP records, archive pulled 2026-11-12 (raw/donki/MANIFEST.json); labelled by scripts/ingest.mjs
note: All 98 flares followed by space rays and all 326 that were not are kept. Only 8 of the followed flares are our real storms with a known size and curve; for the other 90 the outcome is real but the storm's size is not in our data, so the game uses a small storm and says so.
